description: Read the DNS records VibeDeploy tracks for a site (host, type, value), oldest first, including custom-domain verification records. Read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes a DNS record.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: list_dns_records

records.description: DNS records VibeDeploy tracks for this site, oldest first.

domain.description: The host the record applies to (FQDN).

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, or CUSTOM_VERIFIED (an internal marker for a verified custom domain).

title: List DNS records for a site
